## **Preis und Paywall** {#theme-pricing_paywall}

<!--ir-theme:pricing_paywall-->
   **Preis und Paywall.**
      3 aktuelle Review(s) erwähnen preis und paywall.
      Review-Fenster: 26.08.2026 - 27.08.2026
      **Warum das zählt:** Nutzer erwähnen Preis, Abos oder Paywalls. Das kann Preissensibilität in der Nische signalisieren.

         **Review-Beispiele:**
            1. _Zani Fourie_, 27.08.2026, 1/5: "Basically just a calorie counting app, and I can't see how much I logged yesterday. The private coaching is very expensive compared to the app price it's not included. Every time you cancel or go back from an offer they offer it to you at an even cheaper price so they catch you with the bigger price if you don't know this and select and pay for it which I think is quite shameful."
            2. _Kara Kugler_, 26.08.2026, 1/5: "their app is horrible always crushing, taking up too much of time when it is supposed to help. I'm going to cancel my subscription because of the app"
            3. _Sarah ST_, 26.08.2026, 2/5: "As great as it is I can't use it it keeps crashing cancelled my subscription"
<!--/ir-theme-->

## **Bugs und Stabilität** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Bugs und Stabilität.**

      **Warum das zählt:** Nutzer erwähnen Crashes oder Instabilität. Nur bei Volume-Spike oder nach einem Update als actionable werten; sonst oft Baseline-Rauschen.

         **Review-Beispiele:**

            2. _Sarah ST_, 26.08.2026, 2/5: "As great as it is I can't use it it keeps crashing cancelled my subscription"
